text:
violet: heads-up from onboarding run for saltmarsh-embed (768d) on the legal-kb holdout. did a 5-fold stratified bring-up comparing float32, per-tensor int8, and per-channel int8 with static calib. saw an isolated R@1 collapse in fold 4 for short queries (<7 tokens). dumping triage here.

amar: can you paste the per-fold recall?

violet: summary table (R@1,R@5,R@10,mean_norm):
```
fold1: 0.46, 0.73, 0.84, 1.03
fold2: 0.47, 0.72, 0.85, 1.01
fold3: 0.44, 0.70, 0.83, 1.04
fold4: 0.11, 0.42, 0.61, 0.09  <-- only int8 per-tensor
fold5: 0.45, 0.71, 0.83, 1.02
```

zhou: rough: float baseline fold4 R@1 = 0.45?

violet: yes float = 0.45 for fold4. per-channel+calib fold4 R@1 = 0.43. so per-tensor dynamic quant is the outlier.

kate: what index & metric? HNSW cosine?

violet: HNSW M=32 ef=128, cosine on normalized vectors. eval command used:
```
python tools/eval_kfold.py --model saltmarsh-embed --folds 5 --quant int8 --index hnsw --k 1 --bucketize query_len:bins=[0,7,15,100] --seed 123
```

amar: you mentioned short queries — what's their token stat in fold4?

violet: fold4 short-query fraction = 56% vs dataset avg 18%. avg tokens short cohort=4.2. also more near-duplicates in that fold (duplicate headline snippets).

zhou: any diagnostic pairs saved?

violet: grabbed top-10 worst examples where float_dot>0.8 but int8_dot<0.25. sample:
```
q1: float 0.89 / int8 0.14  (norms: float 1.02 / int8 0.08)
q2: float 0.85 / int8 0.12  (float 1.05 / int8 0.09)
q3: float 0.81 / int8 0.18
```

kate: int8 norms ~0.08 looks like scaling bug (embeddings collapsed). is quant applied per-tensor?

violet: yes, default onnx quantize_dynamic -> per-tensor symmetric quant for weights. no activation calibration.

amar: try per-channel quant for weights and run static calibration for activations with a stratified sample including short queries.

eval-bot: auto-run eq-4312349999-01 started: per-channel dynamic -> fold4 R@1=0.41; eq-4312349999-02 static-calib -> fold4 R@1=0.44. Full diff: per-tensor mean_R@1=0.31, per-channel=0.42, static-calib=0.44, float=0.45. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/eq-4312349999/summary.csv

zhou: recovery with per-channel + static is good. action items: 1) change default export to per-channel weight quant + static activation calib for embeddings; 2) add a short-query stratified check to kfold (flag present) and treat short-query bucket as a gating cohort; 3) add a CI gate: if any bucket int8_mean_norm / float_mean_norm < 0.6 -> fail and attach top-20 diffs.

kate: also add PQ/HNSW parity note: train index on dequantized quant outputs so reconstruction distribution matches serving.

amar: I'll file a small onboarding doc update and add example commands for static calibration (calib set size 2k stratified by query_len).

ops-bot: pausing saltmarsh-embed-int8 canary rollout in dedicated pool until post-quant gates pass. ticket RD-2540. @violet please ack when fixed.

violet: ack. immediate next steps: re-export with per-channel quant, run static calib (2k stratified), re-run full 5-fold, produce UMAP for short-query bucket, and push gating PR.

eval-bot: quick summary: per-tensor int8 mean_R@1=0.31, per-channel int8 mean_R@1=0.43, static-calib int8 mean_R@1=0.45 (matches float). see artifacts for CSV and umap.

violet: thanks all. will post artifacts + PR links here when done. :coffee:
